description: This file implements motion activity and pedometer data handling within an Android application, including data classes, a data source interface with its system implementation, and a handler class for processing motion-related requests. It interacts with device sensors to determine user activity state (walking, running, stationary, etc.) and step count, providing an API for motion data retrieval with permission checks and JSON-based request parsing.

classes.name: MotionActivityRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request for motion activity data, including optional start and end ISO timestamps and a limit for the number of records.

classes.name: MotionPedometerRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request for pedometer data, with optional start and end ISO timestamps.

classes.name: MotionActivityRecord
classes.description: Data class representing the result of a motion activity detection, including timestamps, confidence level, and activity states.

classes.name: PedometerRecord
classes.description: Data class representing pedometer data including steps, distance, and floors ascended/descended.

classes.name: MotionDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods to check availability and permissions for activity and pedometer sensors, and to fetch activity and pedometer data.

classes.name: SystemMotionDataSource
classes.description: Implementation of MotionDataSource that interacts with Android hardware sensors to supply motion data.

classes.name: MotionHandler
classes.description: Main class handling motion-related API requests, parsing JSON parameters, checking permissions, and returning JSON results using the system data source.

methods.name: isActivityAvailable
methods.description: Checks if accelerometer sensor is available on the device.

methods.name: isPedometerAvailable
methods.description: Checks if step counter sensor is available on the device.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION permission.

methods.name: activity
methods.description: Performs a motion activity measurement, returning activity type and confidence based on accelerometer samples.

methods.name: pedometer
methods.description: Performs a pedometer reading, returning steps count and other metrics.

methods.name: handleMotionActivity
methods.description: Processes a motion activity request from JSON parameters, returning activity data or error.

methods.name: handleMotionPedometer
methods.description: Processes a pedometer data request from JSON parameters, returning pedometer data or error.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks overall availability of motion capabilities.

methods.name: isActivityAvailable
methods.description: Checks if activity detection is available.

methods.name: isPedometerAvailable
methods.description: Checks if pedometer detection is available.

methods.name: parseActivityRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters to create a MotionActivityRequest object.

methods.name: parsePedometerRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters to create a MotionPedometerRequest object.

methods.name: forTesting
methods.description: Factory method for creating a MotionHandler with a custom data source for testing.
